levels.surface: أبي قتادة علي بن محمد بن حفص

notes: «أبي» is the compiler's father, named only by relation, so `relation`; «رضي الله عنه» is an honorific
«أبي قتادة علي بن محمد بن حفص» is one man (kunya followed by name, no «و» between); «أخيه» is folded into the name (rule 7)
Musa b. Ja'far comes after «عن» so stays `narrator`; «قال: قلت» is Ali b. Ja'far asking, and the answer is Musa's words
